summary.text: Mitch McConnell is the U.S. Senator for Kentucky and, according to his Senate office, the state's longest-serving senator; he defeated an incumbent Democrat in 1984.

paragraphs.text: He led the Senate Republican conference from 2006 to 2024 and was Senate Majority Leader from 2015 to 2021.
He graduated from the University of Louisville and the University of Kentucky College of Law.
He is married to Elaine Chao, a former U.S. Secretary of Transportation and Secretary of Labor.
